read.thesis: Dow Q4'25 EBITDA $741M with Q1'26 guided to ~$750M; supply cuts (20% of North American PO capacity, three European assets) and a $2B Transform to Outperform plan lead, but margins are at bottom-of-cycle.

utilisation.quote: we ran them hard. We set an ethylene production record even with a good cracker idled in Europe.

capex.peers_comment: Management noted industry capacity rationalizations and the cutting of ethylene capacity, including European shutdowns.
capex.quote: we anticipate that Dow's CapEx spending will remain at or below D&A until we see mid-cycle earnings.

triggers.label: PO capacity: 20% of NA removed
triggers.quote: rationalizing approximately 20% of North American PO industry capacity

triggers.label: Europe cracker/asset shutdowns: $200M EBITDA by 2029
triggers.quote: expected to result in an annual EBITDA uplift of $200 million by 2029

triggers.label: NA PE inventory drawdown supports Q1 pricing
triggers.quote: The drawdown in inventories at the end of the year in North America has really helped as we lean into the first quarter.

triggers.label: Q1'26 EBITDA ~ $750M
triggers.quote: Our expectations for first quarter EBITDA is approximately $750 million.

triggers.label: Construction & durables weak
triggers.quote: the building and construction end markets and durables just really offset that

guidance.quote: Our expectations for first quarter EBITDA is approximately $750 million.
we anticipate at least $2 billion of near-term uplift from this work
Our outlook for CapEx for this year is still $2.5 billion like we spent last year.
